name: show_schedule
description: Show a day of the person's calendar as a timeline: the day, a line saying what matters about it (how busy, when they are free), and each event in order with its time, what it is and where. Use it whenever you tell the person what a day holds, from their calendar, rather than listing the events in words; one day per call. Only shows it; there is no reply.

day.description: The day, as the person reads it, e.g. Thursday 5 November

place.description: Where: a place, or how it is joined, e.g. Valletta office, Meet

start.description: When it starts, 24-hour, e.g. 09:30; All day for an all-day event

title.description: What it is, e.g. Contract review with Roberta

summary.description: What matters about the day in a few words, e.g. Busy until 15:00, then free
